title: Just Juice Desserts Strawberry Cheesecake 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Desserts Strawberry Cheesecake is a rich and layered e-liquid that faithfully recreates the profile of a classic bakery favourite. The blend opens with the taste of sweet, ripe Strawberry, which is softened by a velvety layer of creamy Cheesecake. On the exhale, a subtle note of buttery Biscuit creates a warm and satisfying finish. This profile pairs the brightness of the fruit with the indulgence of the cream and pastry notes, ensuring a satisfying and well-rounded vape experience. Uniquely formulated with a 60PG/40VG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed to deliver exceptional flavour clarity and a discreet amount of vapour. This higher PG content makes it ideal for use with low-powered pod vape kits and starter devices, where it ensures efficient wicking and consistent performance. The premium nicotine salt formula provides a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction, even at the higher 20mg strength. For the best experience, we recommend using this e-liquid with coils or pods rated between 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm. The Desserts collection by Just Juice represents a shift from their signature fruity and ice-infused blends, focusing instead on comforting, bakery-inspired profiles. Expertly crafted in the UK, this range is designed to offer depth, balance, and smooth satisfaction for vapers seeking a richer taste experience. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Just Juice Desserts provide a versatile option for adult smokers and vapers alike.
